app.title: Wordleaf

lobby.title: Lobby

levels.name: Easy
levels.desc: Random words. The decoy card only has themes that are not on the clover, so it is easy to spot.

levels.name: Medium
levels.desc: Random words, but each word on the decoy card shares a theme with a word next to a clue (like Lion and Tiger), so it looks like it belongs.

levels.name: Hard
levels.desc: The whole clover and the decoy come from about three themes (like animals, food and weather). Clues have to be precise, and every card looks like it could fit anywhere.

rules: Everyone gets a clover with 4 word cards. Each leaf touches two words.
Write one single-word clue per leaf that links both words.
Then each clover is solved in turn: the cards are shuffled with one extra decoy card, and the others have to place and rotate them correctly using the clues.
The author stays silent! All 4 right on the first try: 6 points. Otherwise the correct cards stay, the rest go back, and a second try scores 1 point per correct card.
